messages:
Mira: Heads-up — Snowcap (HW) + RedBarn (SI) want to list OpenQuill (BYOW) as a bundled marketplace SKU. Need licensing clarity, KMS flow, and a co-announcement plan. Target launch 2026-05-10. Thoughts?
Ajay: Tight timeline but doable if legal + eng clear the gates. Marketing needs assets by 2026-04-10.
Lina: Quick flag — what's the OpenQuill license? If it's copyleft (AGPL/SSPL) we can't rehost redistributed binaries without specific permission. Need the supplier's distribution addendum.
Kevin (RedBarn): OpenQuill team said their weights are "permitted for redistribution under a permissive addendum" — they offered a simple redistribution addendum we can share. They want EU+US availability only.
Sam: For BYOW we need two integration modes: 1) marketplace-hosted bundle where customer spins up with a Snowcap image + RedBarn config and OpenQuill model pulled from their S3; 2) customer-managed where we supply orchestration only. Each has different KMS/keyflow. Which one are we certifying?
Mira: We want option 1 (hosted bundle) for the initial launch — simpler UX and better telemetry for partners. Option 2 can follow.
Lina: If hosted, legal requires: proof-of-origin, signed hash for weights, and an explicit redistribution grant from OpenQuill. Also geo-blocking needs to be in the contract (EU+US only).
Ajay: Priya, can marketing prepare co-announcement copy and a joint customer-facing FAQ that explains availability and support matrix? Need draft by 2026-04-15.
Priya (Marketing): On it. Will need partner logos, a short tech blurb, and a quote from RedBarn. Can someone confirm the embargo window?
Kevin (RedBarn): RedBarn prefers a simultaneous market release in both regions and a 48-hour embargo for partner release sync.
Sam: Technical Q: if we host weights, we must integrate per-customer KMS keys and support key rotation. Proposed flow: customers provide a KMS envelope, we pull the encrypted weights from OpenQuill S3, decrypt with customer key in a sealed runtime. Ops must validate key policy.
Mira: Sounds right. Lina — would that KMS model satisfy the redistribution clause?
Lina: Yes, if OpenQuill signs an attestation that their artifact can be redistributed under those hosting constraints, and we include an indemnity carve-out for tampering. Need their signature on the addendum.
Ajay: Example SKU draft:```sku: SNW-OPQ-BUNDLE-v1
components:
  - snowcap-edge-image: 1.0
  - redbarn-si-config: r2
  - openquill-weights: byow-hosted
region: [us, eu]
embargo: 48h
```
Mira: Perfect — Sam, ops, can you validate this SKU maps to our billing/pricing schema? We need per-hour GPU + a one-time SI setup fee.
Sam: Will do. Two follow-ups: 1) need a test vector from OpenQuill to validate quality regressions; 2) a deployment test run with Snowcap hardware in our staging lab (I can schedule next week).
deploy-bot: scheduled test run: staging-snowcap-01 -> 2026-03-29T08:00Z (uid: run-8871) :white_check_mark:
Kevin (RedBarn): We'll provide logos and a RedBarn quote by 2026-04-05. OpenQuill legal is circling back on the addendum this week.
Priya (Marketing): Noted. Draft comms timeline: internal dry-run 2026-04-20, press-ready assets 2026-04-28, partner embargo window week of 2026-05-04, public roll week of 2026-05-10.
Lina: I'll prepare the legal checklist and a redline of OpenQuill's addendum. If they accept, legal approval should be able to turn around in 3 business days.
Mira: Great. Action items: Lina to review addendum (due 2026-03-31), Sam to validate SKU/pricing + run staging test (scheduled), Priya to draft comms (due 2026-04-15), Kevin to share partner assets and addendum from OpenQuill. I'll coordinate announcement cadence with Sales for enterprise outreach. :thumbsup:
Ajay: Let's reconvene 2026-03-30 for a quick sync after legal sees the addendum. :eyes:
